plain: Money paid each year to a person, such as one who has retired

webster.text: An annual allowance of a sum of money to a person by government in consideration of past services, civil or military.

example.quote: May there not be a variety of pensions granted to the judges in England, so as to influence them ? and cannot they be removed by a vote of both houses of Parliament?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 23, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
